lambada.tokenization: No special tokens; encode full text and context; take suffix after exact context-token prefix. Prevents artificial isolated SentencePiece leading-space token.
lambada.accuracy: All target subword tokens are top-1 under teacher forcing; equivalent to exact greedy target-word completion.
lambada.ppl: exp(-sum(word loglikelihood)/5153), word-level LAMBADA harness PPL; also retain target-token PPL.

wikitext.scoring: Every full disjoint 2048 block; shifted FP32 CE; no overlap; logically reset caches each block; no fitting
